## Codex execution contract

**CGS-16 review and evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional; when unavailable, report that limit and do not claim they ran. Preserve previous user authorization and the current host permissions. Use actual data and sourced registry/GDD targets; show each outlier and computation, and leave absent ranges or domains NOT ASSESSED rather than inventing them. Recommendations are not data edits. A report or fix requires separate applicable authorization.
